decisions.reason: The photo-selection rule is owned by the photo-inclusion Requirement and does not change the existing full-document layout or graphic-treatment rules.
Selecting required photos does not change which supplied narrative sections or subsection content must be included.
The marked-photo selection rule does not alter the Agua Arc identity, logo source, or brand-color source.
Required photo selection does not change Canva ownership, editability, asset restrictions, or reuse rights.
The instruction identifying required photos does not change the requirement to include a table of contents.
The photo-selection instruction does not change how the organization chart must be incorporated.
The source decision concerns photos only and does not modify inclusion of the budget sheet or supplied proposal tables.
Selecting required photos does not alter the fixed section order or the prohibition on section reordering.
The task-local photo-selection instruction does not change the deferred reusable-template design or its modular features.
The client requires specific photos but does not revise the existing page-count target.
Required photo inclusion does not change the print-ready PDF deliverable condition.
